analysis.jiraIssueSummary: GEM-32461 Story: Add invoice-linking controls (Add to Existing Invoice / Add to New Invoice) to the order screen footer (not cart), with mandatory-field gating, open-invoice visibility rules, redirect behavior, existing linking logic reuse, and eyeglasses makeability check (PV scope only).
requirementOrBugAnalysis: Story scope is UI/flow enhancement on order screen footer: provide two actions to link order to invoice without returning to cart.
Both invoice actions are constrained by existing order-to-invoice logic/validation; no new linking rules are defined.
Add to New Invoice is disabled until all mandatory order fields are completed.
Add to Existing Invoice is hidden when patient has no invoices in Open status.
Clicking Add to Existing Invoice opens a dropdown above the button listing all Open invoices.
Selecting an Open invoice links the order to that invoice and redirects user to invoice page.
Clicking Add to New Invoice links order to newly created invoice and redirects user to invoice page.
If opening an order already linked to an Open invoice, both link buttons are hidden.
Eyeglasses orders must run makeability check before linking for either action, per GEM-28947 current rules.
Applicability is explicitly PV only; wholesale behavior excluded and tracked separately.
missingInformation: Exact definition/list of 'mandatory order fields' is not provided in this ticket.
No explicit expected behavior when Add to Existing Invoice dropdown has many items (sorting, pagination, search, truncation) is provided.
No explicit UI text/error behavior defined for makeability check failure on eyeglasses in this story.
No explicit permission/role constraints are defined for visibility/clickability of invoice actions.
No explicit behavior defined if open-invoice list changes between dropdown open and selection (stale data/concurrency).
No acceptance criteria provided for API/network failure during link/create-and-link actions.
No attachment content is available here to validate visual details from image-20260622-094231.png.
ambiguities: Description states 'two invoice actions are available' and also says Add to Existing is hidden when no open invoices; wording could be interpreted as conditionally available.
Global statement says both actions remain disabled until mandatory fields complete, but section behavior only explicitly disables Add to New Invoice; Add to Existing enable/disable state is unclear.
Behavior when order is linked to a non-open invoice is not specified for button visibility.
Whether dropdown should refresh open invoices on each click or use cached list is not specified.
Redirect destination detail (invoice details page vs specific tab/section) is not specified.
risks: Inconsistent gating between Add to New and Add to Existing could allow invalid linking before required fields are complete.
Incorrect visibility logic may expose Add to Existing when no open invoices, causing dead-end UX.
Regression risk to existing cart-screen invoice linking flow and shared linking backend logic.
Makeability check integration risk for eyeglasses could be bypassed or double-triggered.
PV-only scope risk: accidental impact on wholesale if tenant/channel scoping is not enforced.
Concurrency risk if selected open invoice becomes closed before linking is submitted.
dependencies: Invoice status data source for patient invoices (Open status filtering).
Navigation/routing to invoice page after successful link.
Linked issue GEM-38725 (Ordering Testing) for broader testing coordination.
clarificationQuestions: Should Add to Existing Invoice also be disabled until all mandatory fields are completed, or only Add to New Invoice?
What are the exact mandatory order fields in PV context for this gating?
If order is already linked to a non-open invoice, should the two buttons be shown or hidden?
How should open invoices be ordered in dropdown (e.g., newest first, invoice number, due date)?
What should user see when makeability check fails for eyeglasses (message text, blocking behavior, stay on order page)?
What is expected behavior on API/network errors when creating/linking invoice (toast/modal, retry option, no redirect)?
Are there role-based access rules for these actions that must be enforced/tested?
Should dropdown list refresh at open time to reflect real-time invoice status changes?
recommendedTestScenarios: Validate footer shows both invoice actions on eligible PV order screen.
Validate mandatory-field gating behavior for Add to New (and Add to Existing once clarified).
Validate Add to Existing hidden state when patient has zero Open invoices.
Validate Add to Existing dropdown opens above button and lists only Open invoices.
Validate selecting an Open invoice links order and redirects to correct invoice page.
Validate Add to New creates/links new invoice and redirects to invoice page.
Validate when opening order already linked to an Open invoice, both actions are hidden.
Validate eyeglasses orders trigger makeability check before linking for both actions.
Negative: validate failed makeability blocks linking and prevents redirect.
Negative: validate backend/API failure for link/create does not produce false-success redirect.
Boundary: patient with exactly 1 Open invoice and with multiple Open invoices.
Regression: existing cart-screen linking flow remains unchanged.
Regression/integration: existing invoice-link validation rules still enforced.

detailedTestCases.title: Verify that order footer displays invoice actions for PV orders
preconditions: User opens order screen for a patient with at least one Open invoice.
Order is not already linked to an Open invoice.

steps.action: Navigate to the order form footer.
steps.expected: Add to Existing Invoice and Add to New Invoice controls are visible.

detailedTestCases.title: Verify that Add to New Invoice remains disabled until mandatory fields are completed
preconditions: Order screen is open and order is not linked to an Open invoice.

steps.action: Leave at least one mandatory field empty.
steps.expected: Add to New Invoice is disabled and cannot be triggered.
Add to New Invoice becomes enabled.

detailedTestCases.title: Verify that Add to Existing Invoice is hidden when no Open invoices exist
preconditions: Patient has zero invoices with Open status.
Order is not linked to an Open invoice.

steps.action: Open order screen and inspect footer.
steps.expected: Add to Existing Invoice is not displayed.

detailedTestCases.title: Verify that Add to Existing Invoice opens dropdown with only Open invoices
preconditions: Patient has multiple invoices with mixed statuses including Open.
Order is not linked to an Open invoice.

steps.expected: Only invoices in Open status are listed; non-Open invoices are absent.

detailedTestCases.title: Verify that selecting an Open invoice links the order and redirects to invoice page
preconditions: Patient has at least one Open invoice.
Order has all mandatory fields completed.

steps.action: Click Add to Existing Invoice and select an Open invoice.
steps.expected: System links current order to selected invoice.
User is redirected to the selected invoice page.

detailedTestCases.title: Verify that clicking Add to New Invoice creates link and redirects to invoice page
preconditions: Order has all mandatory fields completed.
Order is not already linked to an Open invoice.

steps.expected: A new invoice is created and order is linked to it using existing logic.
User is redirected to the newly created invoice page.

detailedTestCases.title: Verify that invoice-link controls are hidden when order is already linked to an Open invoice
preconditions: Existing order is linked to an Open invoice.

steps.action: Open the linked order on order screen.
steps.expected: Add to Existing Invoice and Add to New Invoice controls are hidden.

detailedTestCases.title: Verify that eyeglasses Add to Existing Invoice flow runs makeability check before linking
preconditions: Patient has at least one Open invoice.

steps.action: Click Add to Existing Invoice and select an Open invoice.
steps.expected: Makeability check is executed before link operation.
Order is linked and user is redirected to invoice page.

detailedTestCases.title: Verify that eyeglasses Add to New Invoice flow runs makeability check before linking

steps.expected: Makeability check is executed before creating/linking invoice.
New invoice is created, order is linked, and redirect occurs.

detailedTestCases.title: Verify that failed makeability prevents invoice linking for eyeglasses orders
preconditions: Test data that causes makeability failure.

steps.action: Attempt Add to New Invoice (or Add to Existing Invoice).
steps.expected: Linking is blocked when makeability fails and no invoice redirect occurs.

regressionConsiderations: Re-test cart-screen invoice actions to ensure no behavior regressions from shared linking logic changes.
Re-test existing order-to-invoice validations (eligibility/rules) still enforced identically.
Re-test invoice page load/routing after linking to ensure deep links and context remain correct.
Re-test non-eyeglasses order flows to confirm no unintended makeability invocation.
Re-test PV vs wholesale separation to ensure wholesale behavior is unchanged.
